name: Terri-Fried
author: PolyMars
description_short: Launch an egg between falling platforms, collect coins, and stay above the lava
description_long: Terri-Fried is a score-chasing action game for the Nintendo GameCube. Use the control stick and A button to set the egg's trajectory, land on falling platforms, and collect as many coins as possible without plunging into the lava. Created in 72 hours for Ludum Dare 46.
